visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up shot of a white bowl containing thick rice noodles in a clear broth, garnished with fried shallots and green onions. Bold white text reading '傳統米粉湯' and a small 'wecook123' logo are superimposed. (2) A person's hands using yellow floral-shaped tongs submerge a large piece of raw pork and several triangular pieces of golden fried tofu into a pot of boiling water on a black stove. The kitchen setting is brightly lit with overhead studio lighting. (3) The scene cuts to a black frying pan where oil is poured from small glass bowls, followed by sliced shallots. The hands sauté the shallots until they are fragrant. (4) A large pot is filled with water and a bundle of thick rice noodles. The blanched pork and tofu are added back in, along with salt and white pepper. A glass lid is placed over the pot to simmer. (5) The lid is removed to reveal the boiling soup. A hand uses a blue spatula to add chopped celery, green garlic, and more fried shallots. (6) On a wooden cutting board, the cooked pork is sliced into uniform pieces. In a separate glass bowl, a hand wearing a white glove mixes chopped red chilies, garlic, sugar, and soy sauce. (7) The prepared sauce is drizzled over the sliced pork. A close-up shows a piece of pork being lifted with wooden chopsticks. The final noodle soup is presented as the creator signs off.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 傳統米粉湯. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Subtitle]: 大家好，今天教大家用簡單幾個食材做出北部最傳統的古早味米粉湯囉. (3) [Subtitle]: 滾水呢，我們先把這三層肉先把它過水. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後這油豆腐，讓它整個豆腐的毛細孔打開來，待會下去煮的時候呢，很快它就可以吸滿它的湯汁. (5) [Subtitle]: 接下來就要打底了，香油跟我們的沙拉油. (6) [Subtitle]: 紅蔥頭呢，稍微把它炒香，米酒. (7) [Subtitle]: 有兩千的水加進去，配一包的米粉. (8) [Subtitle]: 肉跟油豆腐、鹽巴、白胡椒粉. (9) [Subtitle]: 我們就把它上蓋，讓它去慢慢煮一下. (10) [Subtitle]: 過了十五分鐘到二十分鐘，芹菜. (11) [Subtitle]: 加個蒜苗、油蔥酥、蒜酥. (12) [Subtitle]: 順便小菜也做好了，我要做一個沾醬. (13) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭辣椒、醬油膏、糖. (14) [Subtitle]: 好，來一點醬油，蔥花，來一點水. (15) [Subtitle]: 我們的醬已經做好了. (16) [Subtitle]: 好，肉切好，我們就上桌啦. [Logo]: wecook123. (17) [Subtitle]: 喜歡呢，你試做看看喔. [Logo]: wecook123.

(2) A sharp, wet splash and light hissing sound occurs as meat is blanched. The speaker's volume remains steady. (3) A clear clinking of glass or ceramic containers is heard, followed by a continuous sizzling sound of oil heating. The BGM maintains a steady rhythmic beat. (4) A distinctive liquid-into-liquid pouring sound lasts for two seconds. The narrator continues explaining the ingredient list with high clarity. (5) A dull metallic thud from a lid being placed on a pot is heard. The BGM remains prominent but subordinate to the vocals. (6) A short sequence of sharp, rhythmic thuds against a wooden surface indicates chopping. The background environment is studio-clean with minimal noise. (7) Rhythmic metallic clinking of a spoon against glass as the sauce is mixed. (8) A final pouring sound and a squelching liquid effect as sauce is applied. The narrator concludes with a warm, energetic farewell as the BGM fades out.
